NAME OF BIDDER: ………………………………………………………………………………… ……………………. Sr. Pre-qualification Criteria Technical Pre-qualification criteria: The bidding shall be manufacturer/ authorized dealer of “pneumatically ope rated ON-OFF ball Valves”. Bidders shall furnish documents fulfilling require ments of the Pre-Qualification criteria in clause A to B mentioned below alon g with Bid, in support of their bid/s. Following bid-qualification criteria shall be part of the indent with attached s pecifications. (Documentary support to substantiate bidder’s credential against following clauses must be submitted in the following format). A) TECHNICAL CAPABILITY / CAPACITY: a. Party shall submit complete Technical Details of Product Man ufactured along with the Product Catalogue indicating technical specifications and model number for which pre-qualification is s ought. b. Details of Manufacturing Facilities Available & it should ISO certifi ed. c. In case of authorized representative, bidder shall submit vali d authorization certificate from OEM with clearly mentioning aut horization for our area for sales & services of offer product mak e and model. d. Manufacturing facility should maintain as per global quality pr ocedure and should be capable for manufacturing of SIL Certifie d ball valves. Offered valve body assembly and pneumatic actu ator should be SIL3 Certified. A valid SIL Certificate from the cer 1 tifying agencies (e.g. TUV, Exida) for the model offered shall be provided. e. Availability of After Sales Service and Spares. Valve manufac turer should support for spares for next 10 years. B) PAST PERFORMANCE / EXPERIENCE:

The bidder/OEM, must have designed, manufactured and supplied und er third party inspection (e.g. Lloyds Register/ BVIS/DNV/TUV) pneumat ically operated ON-OFF ball Valves of minimum 2 inch, 1500# RTJ ratin g to the fertilizers, Refineries and the same shall be operating satisfact orily after installation continuously at least for TWO years. As a documentary proof, the bidder shall submit self-attested photo co pies of following documents. i) Copy of at least one Purchase Order issued and executed during last 7 years ending last day of month previous to the one in whi ch applications are invited for last supplied valve. The ball valve PO referred for the prequalification and the control valve model offered in this tender shall be of same model. PO copy shall hav e full technical details of the item indicating Valve type, model, Size, Rating, Body Material and service. If the bidder is authoriz ed dealer, PO copy of supplied material from OEM is also accept able. ii) Certificate from user regarding satisfactory performance of th e valve after installation at least for TWO years. If party is unabl e to submit the satisfactory performance certificate, then party shall submit contact details such as contact person name, conta ct no. and email ID of the customer. RCF will try to get the perfo rmance from the customer directly and if the performance from the customer is not found satisfactory, then the party’s offer sh all be rejected.

Financial: - A) Turnover / audited annual reports: Last three years financial audited reports or Turnover certificate from C hartered Accountant (CA) as below: Average Annual financial turnover during the last three years, ending 3 1st March of the previous financial year (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-2 6) should be at least (Required minimum Avg. turnover of Rs. 17.99 L akh). The Turnover should be issued by practicing CA with Membership Num ber, seal and signed with UDIN. Bidder shall submit audited annual reports certified by Chartered Accou ntant (CA) or Turnover certificates for above financial years. Turnover c ertificates should be issued by practicing CA with membership number, 2 seal and signed. Certificate / document issued by Chartered Accountant will be valid and accepted only with UDIN number. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 years old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account. In this c ase, the financial turnover during last financial year / the average finan cial turnover during preceding two financial years should be at least Rs . 17.99 Lakh. i. Relaxation in financial criteria for eligible MSEs 1. For MSEs- Relaxation of 25% in Annual financial turnover shall be p rovided to the qualifying MSEs. ii. Relaxation in financial criteria for eligible startup as per attach ed annexure. Successful bidder will have to submit the Security Deposit (SD) f or 5% of total contract value within 14 days from receipt of P.O i n the form of bank guarantee as per RCF format from RCF’s app roved list of Bankers covering the delivery period plus 2 months . SPECIAL NOTE: Security Dep osit A) If the SD is not deposited within the stipulated 14-day period, the SD will be recovered along with Interest from the due date o f Deposit from the first payment. The interest rate shall be the a pplicable Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) + 2% or MC 3 LR (6 months) + 2% as applicable.

Successful bidder will have to submit Performance Bank Guaran tee for same value as that of Security deposit within 15 days fro m the date of supply of material in the form of bank guarantee Performance as per RCF format from RCF approved banker covering the perio BG for supply d of 20 months from the date of supply. SD submitted in the fo rm of Bank guarantee can be converted in to PBG. Bidder shall furnish warranty certificate for a period of 18 mont Warranty Cer 4 hs from the date of supply or 12 months from the date of commi tificate ssioning whichever is earlier against any manufacturing defects Bidder shall submit duly filled, signed and stamped copy of the i ntegrity pact along with the offer with date mentioned on each page of IP. signing of integrity pact is pre-requisite for pre-qualif ication in the enquiry. Integrity Pac (Note: RCF has accepted and agreed to the terms and conditio 5 t ns of the Integrity Pact. The Bidder, as a token of acceptance of the terms and conditions of the Integrity Pact with sign and sta mp the Integrity Pact and submit the same with bid documents. Signing the Integrity Pact is a pre-requisite for pre-qualification and Integrity Pact and NIT conditions will form part of the contra ct). A pre-bid meeting shall be conducted at RCF Thal, Alibag, Raiga d, Maharashtra – 402208. Any queries related to the pre-bid meeting shall be sent to RCF via email at vikrant.patil@rcfltd.com or vbjoshi@rcfltd.com at least 2 (two) d ays prior to the scheduled pre-bid meeting. Pre-Bid meet 6 ing Bidders may also participate in the pre-bid meeting through Vid eo Conferencing (VC). Bidders intending to participate through VC shall submit their request at least 2 (two) days before the meeting along wit h the queries if any. The VC meeting link will be shared with such bidders acc ordingly.
